candidates.claim: OUTSIDE_IN, bound inbound on the outside interface, is the first entry matching and permits any source (0.0.0.0/0) to reach 10.10.10.21/32 (OT) on tcp/22, so Internet connections directly into the OT side are allowed.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OUTSIDE_IN permit entry for tcp/22 to 10.10.10.21 so that OUTSIDE traffic to OT is denied.

candidates.claim: The effective OUTSIDE_IN permit allows tcp/22 from the Internet to the OT host 10.10.10.21, which is not an approved cross-zone service (only tcp/5450 from SCADA servers, udp/123 and tcp/8530 from OT, and tcp/3389 from the jump host are approved).
candidates.remediation: Remove the OUTSIDE_IN permit entry for tcp/22 to 10.10.10.21 so that the only OT-side paths are the approved services.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison lists the OUTSIDE_IN access-list line at fw-01:59 (tcp/22 permit to 10.10.10.21) as added relative to the approved baseline, so it is an unreconciled deviation.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OUTSIDE_IN line at fw-01:59 with the engineer: either approve it through change control or remove it and restore the baseline.

The registry says IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers must be disabled, but also permits HTTPS/ASDM management from MGMT on fw-01. Is an enabled ASA HTTP server with MGMT-only access on the mgmt interface acceptable under the management policy, or should it be disabled?
